entry.title: Guideline on Corruption Prevention issued by Hong Kong Association of Banks
entry.summary: HKMA's circular to all authorized institutions introduces HKAB's guideline. HKMA expects assessment against its good practices, enhancements where appropriate, and a compliance-status report by end-Q3 2027. The circular describes the guideline as a consolidated reference that reinforces existing regulations and statutory requirements.

entry.title: GC26/9: Cyber risk and resilience management
entry.summary: The FCA, PRA and Bank of England opened a joint consultation on non-Handbook guidance that clarifies existing UK rules. It sets draft proportionate cyber-risk and recovery expectations for specified UK firms; responses close 26 February 2027 and the source expects final guidance in H1 2027.

entry.title: Government welcomes passage of Banking Legislation (Miscellaneous Amendments) Bill 2026
entry.summary: The Government announced Legislative Council passage of the Banking Legislation (Miscellaneous Amendments) Ordinance 2026. It amends banking legislation on bank holding companies, skilled-person engagement, enforcement, the banking-system structure, technical matters and resolution-related legislation; phased commencement starts 1 January 2027.

entry.title: MAS and ABS Set Out PayNow Generation 2 Implementation Roadmap
entry.summary: MAS and ABS published a Singapore PayNow Gen2 roadmap covering staged enhancements to QR interoperability, deep-linking, selected higher-value government payments, person-to-merchant dispute arrangements, richer payment data and micropayment testing. The roadmap targets foundational standards and trials by end-2027, with staged expansion in 2028; it is a coordinated implementation roadmap rather than an immediate MAS rule.

entry.title: Circular on DPRK sanctions-list update
entry.summary: The SFC reported an amendment to a DPRK sanctions-list entity record and publication of the updated Hong Kong list. It expects licensed firms and their associated entities to screen new or revised designations against client lists as soon as practicable whenever there are updates.

entry.title: Research report on AI adoption, governance and compliance
entry.summary: HKIMR released research on GenAI and agentic-AI adoption in Hong Kong financial services, including regulatory-compliance use. The research identifies explainability and security as adoption challenges and does not establish a regulatory requirement.

entry.title: HKMA and Swift continue collaboration on Project Ensemble and Swift ledger
entry.summary: HKMA and Swift are exploring cross-border, multi-currency tokenised-deposit interoperability between the Swift ledger and Project Ensemble’s settlement layer. The collaboration is a market-development update, not a participation mandate, supervisory expectation or production timetable.

entry.title: Inland Revenue (Amendment) (Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework and Amended Common Reporting Standard) Ordinance gazetted
entry.summary: The Legislative Council record states that the Bill passed on 4 November 2026 and that the resulting Ordinance was gazetted on 13 November 2026. The record does not state commencement, transitional arrangements, reporting dates, affected entities or operative requirements.

entry.title: Amendments to HKSCC Rules, Operational Procedures and FINI Terms and Conditions
entry.summary: HKSCC states that SFC-approved amendments effective 16 November 2026 introduce USI transfer role, identity and beneficial-interest check, six-year record-retention and ASR-fee provisions for affected Uncertificated Securities Market participants.

entry.title: Second Reading moved for Securities and Futures (Amendment) Bill 2026
entry.summary: The Second Reading speech describes a Bill that would introduce statutory REIT restructuring and compulsory-acquisition mechanisms and clarify market-misconduct and disclosure coverage for exchange-listed collective investment schemes; implementation remains conditional on passage.

entry.title: HKMA and SFC co-host seminar to advance tokenisation in Hong Kong and promote collaborative opportunities within Project Ensemble
entry.summary: HKMA and SFC described Project Ensemble activity, including 24/7 interbank settlement of tokenised deposits through Ensemble TX and round-the-clock secondary trading for tokenised money-market funds; the release does not require participation.

entry.title: Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes (Amendment) Bill 2026 gazetted
entry.summary: The Bill, gazetted for First Reading on 25 November 2026, proposes a second-tier MPF arrears surcharge, employer information notices, trustee sanctions and member-charge restrictions; it is not a current obligation.

entry.title: Inland Revenue (Amendment) (Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework and Amended Common Reporting Standard) Bill 2026 — ordinance gazetted
entry.summary: The LegCo record states that the Bill passed with Administration amendments on 4 November 2026 and the resulting ordinance was gazetted on 13 November; the retrieved record does not establish commencement, scope or operative duties.

entry.title: SFST moves Second Reading of Securities and Futures (Amendment) Bill 2026
entry.summary: FSTB moved Second Reading of the Bill, which proposes REIT restructuring and compulsory-acquisition mechanisms and extends aspects of market-misconduct and disclosure regulation to listed collective investment schemes. It remains subject to passage; certain disclosure amendments are expected on 4 December 2027.

entry.title: LCQ14: Building international gold trading market
entry.summary: The government reported that the gold clearing and settlement system is in trial operation with 11 provisional direct-participant banks and is planned to launch in Q1 2027. It is to connect with RTGS for delivery-versus-payment before launch; no bank participation requirement or compliance deadline is stated.

entry.title: Northern Metropolis Financial Advisory Taskforce holds its third meeting
entry.summary: HKMA proposes amending the Banking (Capital) Rules to designate specified government-related entities as Domestic Public Sector Entities to support financing for Northern Metropolis projects. The proposal is not enacted; HKMA intends to submit amendments to Legislative Council in Q1 2027, with a view to effect in Q2 2027.

entry.title: Amendments to HKSCC Rules, Operational Procedures and FINI Terms and Conditions
entry.summary: HKSCC states that the SFC approved amendments to its rules, procedures and FINI terms for the Uncertificated Securities Market initiative. The amendments take effect on 16 November 2026 and include defined participant controls for uncertificated securities transfers and ASR-fee arrangements.

entry.title: Government welcomes passage of Inland Revenue (Amendment) (Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework and Amended Common Reporting Standard) Bill 2026
entry.summary: The Government announced that the Legislative Council passed the Bill to implement OECD CARF and amended CRS. Relevant service providers will collect CARF-specified information in 2027 for IRD exchanges from 2028; amended CRS takes effect in 2028 and exchanges begin in 2029. IRD will issue guidance and provide technical support.

entry.title: LCQ1: Policy on the development of digital assets
entry.summary: In a Legislative Council reply, the Government said it and the SFC will introduce a Bill by end-2026 to extend the virtual-asset regime to dealing, advisory, management and custody. FSTB and HKMA are advancing a legislative review on wider distributed-ledger-technology use in fixed income and digital assets. The reply is a policy statement and future legislative intention, not an enacted rule.

entry.title: Future of Finance Institute Commences Operations, Starting with AI in Finance
entry.summary: MAS announced that Singapore's Future of Finance Institute has commenced operations. Its initial AI work includes good practices and practical resources for AI use-case risk assessment, testing and assurance, and third-party AI; the release describes an industry initiative rather than a new binding instrument.
